tam.headline: These crossings are the floor — Mexico's water-crossing market runs far higher
tam.source: finance sheet 'Navier × DiDi Mexico — Corridor Unit Economics' (Market sizing tab, MID) + handoff/partner-map-model/mx-eg-expansion-2026-07-20/didi-mexico-growth-2026-07-21.json

rungs.label: SOM · Today — Navier fares on DiDi's network, serving 10% of current trips
rungs.note: Navier's own transport revenue at a new-entrant ~10% capture of today's crossing demand, extended across the whole mapped Mexican network.

rungs.label: SAM · Near term — faster, quieter boats grow the market, serving 25% at maturity
rungs.note: Navier's own transport revenue once the full addressable Mexican network runs at leading-operator capture, with faster, more comfortable boats growing the market. Mid case shown with a low-high range.

rungs.label: TAM · Full market — the entire sea-transfer market we create
rungs.note: Total annual water-transfer spend the induced Mexican crossing market can support at full network width.

rungs.label: GMV · Whole journey — add food, stays and experiences to every crossing
rungs.note: Door-to-door value of every journey that includes one of these crossings — the full trip DiDi's app coordinates end to end, not only the boat leg.

rungs.label: DiDi platform revenue on Navier — 18% of Navier's journey GMV across the full network
rungs.note: DiDi's platform take on the journey value routed through the Navier network, at DiDi's standard 18% commission.

country_total._vessels_note: Resealed 2026-07-21: Holbox 8.35→5.5nm dropped its fleet 9→8, so the grounded floor is 99 vessels (was 100). Floor revenue rose to $30,047,216 as each Holbox boat now runs more legs/day.

rules.unit_economics_route: single representative exact-bound route; all values bound from the aggregate, never hand-typed
rules.tam_source: SOM full mapped network + SAM/marine-TAM/journey-GMV/platform from the MID Market-sizing ladder (didi census greenfield 5.45); grounded floor = sum of 5 grounded Mexico corridors.
rules.fare_basis: premium-substitute (Uber Black comparable) on Caribbean crossings; Jaideep-approved fixed anchors on new corridors ($20 Huatulco, $12 Holbox, 2026-07-21). Conservative on longer legs.
